mission: Attack lease/stale/retry semantics for false takeover, deadlock, late-return conflict and write collision. Produce falsification cases.
useful_delta: Adversarial inspection of the executable lease/recovery primitives and real recovery artifacts found five blocking/partial boundaries not covered by the green 11-case suite: READ_ONLY_RECOVERY can bypass retryable=false; missing overlap evidence collapses to false and is later asserted as NO_ACTIVE_OVERLAP; unique recovery-attempt IDs do not provide one-winner fencing for a stale generation; a bare RECOVERY_ATTEMPT can refresh latest-signal age without proving worker liveness; and generated recovery-claim schema differs from real persisted recovery claims. Late-return reconciliation exists as a pure primitive but end-to-end durable reconciliation was not found/proven in this audit.

findings.summary: READ_ONLY_RECOVERY can satisfy the retry-safety condition even when retryable=false.
Absent overlap proof is treated as active_overlap=false; generated recovery claims can assert no overlap without evidence ref.
Two workers may create distinct append-only recovery IDs for the same stale generation and both seed runs.
A recovery attempt alone can reset latest-signal age and delay subsequent recovery without STARTED/heartbeat proof.
Builder emits prometeo.recovery-claim/v1 while inspected real recovery evidence uses prometeo.opportunity-recovery-claim/v1 with materially different fields.
Pure reconcileLateReturn preserves both, but no durable end-to-end reconciliation artifact/consumer was located during this audit.

dedup.repair_owner: O-SWARM-LEASE-RETRY-BUILD-V1 follow-up / steward disposition; do not create a competing implementation

source_freshness.concurrency_note: Main and public runtime advanced repeatedly during the run due many parallel workers; all writes by this run were isolated to its own claim/run/return and cross-return scope.

result_summary: COMPLETE critic mission: recovery semantics are PARTIAL and should remain a production blocker until retry proof, overlap proof, one-winner recovery fencing, liveness semantics and schema compatibility are repaired and independently stress-verified.
